title: Body part, strict front (torso, legs, arms, head)
description: One body-essential part cut clean from the strict-front sheet.

body.subject: Reference the attached strict-front A-pose character sheet. Render ONLY the {{part}} of the same character: {{part_extent}}.
body.action: Exact same A-pose orientation as the sheet, no rotation, no tilt, no three-quarter angle.
body.camera: STRICT FRONT VIEW, dead-on; both sides of the part at equal width and equal angle; orthographic framing.
body.style: White background (#FFFFFF), neutral flat lighting; same art style, colour palette, materials and wear as the sheet; sharp focus at 2K.
body.constraints: Clean cuts at the boundaries, no clothing detail hanging off the cut; hands are NOT included in the arms (extracted separately).

part_extent.default: from the base of the neck down to the top of the hips
part_extent.description: the extent: torso neck to hips; legs hips to soles, both together; arms shoulder cap to wrist, side by side at the A-pose angle; head the head and neck, neutral expression

negatives: no environment, shadow or rim lighting

provenance.note: MIT (Copyright (c) 2026 Mr. Mak Workspace contributors); the wording is adapted to Lampway's five-part body and its five-negative cap (the upstream negative list is shipped as the long-negative variant where it is a tuning question)

openai/gpt-image*.note: GPT Image wants the reference order stated in prose and takes an explicit size (<= 3840 per edge, ~8.3 MP)

black-forest-labs/*.note: takes resolution + aspect_ratio; tolerates shorter prompts

google/gemini*.note: takes resolution + aspect_ratio; tolerates shorter prompts

sourceful/*.note: Riverflow: flattest albedo; takes resolution + aspect_ratio
